content:
I have always been on the hunt for ultra-thin accessories that complement my everyday carry items, and I typically pay close attention to how thin tech companies and brands can make their products. For accessories that are too bulky and lack thoughtful storage design, I generally stay away. So, I have tried countless accessories — from external batteries to stands, magnetic cables, and much more. I want to share with you my absolute favorites that are not only ultra-thin and portable but also packed with multiple functions.

Be sure to check out our hands-on video, where we showcase all the devices mentioned here and even more products. The video covers 11 noteworthy slim and lightweight accessories!

This is a recent addition to my EDC, and it performs incredibly well. It is unbelievable that they managed to pack so much functionality into such a slim device. Its thickness is roughly comparable to the camera module on an iPhone. Key features include:

  • Features a Popsocket-style finger ring that can be used with one or two fingers
  • Equipped with an independent adjustable metal stand that rotates 350 degrees
  • Supports both portrait and landscape viewing
  • Dual-sided magnetic design, meaning you can stack more MagSafe accessories on top of the stand

To this day, I cannot figure out how they managed to condense so many functions into such a slim and lightweight stand, but it has become a permanent fixture on my iPhone. It is so thin that you can still wirelessly charge while it is attached! And there is one more great feature — because it is so thin, it actually eliminates the wobble issue when you set your phone down on a table!

The Snap Grip Stand is available on their official website at US$39.99, available in four colors: black, green, light purple, and silver. They also sell the ring component separately at US$29.99, available in 18 colors (so many that I cannot count them all). This product comes highly recommended for any iPhone user.

This one is my timeless favorite. On the surface, it is just another three-in-one charger for your Apple devices, but what truly sets it apart is its build quality, functionality, and value for money. You get:

  • A Qi2.2 25W MagSafe-compatible charger
  • A 5W Apple Watch charger
  • A 5W AirPods charger
  • A foldable CNC aluminum design

This product is incredibly slim and lightweight. The Kuxiu X40 Turbo can be folded down to charge just your iPhone, opened up to serve as a three-in-one charging stand, or laid completely flat. Its thinnest point is only 18mm, and when folded, it can be held in one hand. The best part is that it even comes with the 45W power adapter needed for 25W fast charging, plus a hard carrying case to hold all the accessories. This product is truly underrated.

The Kuxiu X40 Turbo is available on the Kuxiu website at US$78, available in five colorways: gray, black, wood grain, orange, and cherry red. It was the first charger on the market that perfectly matched the Cosmic Orange iPhone! For US$78, you get not only the charger but also a braided cable, a 45W power adapter, and a carrying case.

This is where things get even more interesting. I am a firm believer in ultra-thin magnetic external batteries. Higher-capacity MagSafe batteries have their uses, but if I want to charge my phone while using it, I prefer smaller-capacity batteries so I can top up my phone a little without turning it into a two-pound brick. So far, the thinnest and lightest MagSafe external battery is the SolidSafe Air. Its specs include:

  • 5,000mAh battery capacity
  • Ultra-slim 6.8mm body
  • Supports Qi2 wireless charging up to 15W
  • USB-C output charging up to 20W
  • Can charge two devices simultaneously

I own three of these batteries and bring at least one with me wherever I go. My iPhone 17 Pro can no longer last a full day on a charge, so having one of these is essential for me. They are lightweight, look and feel premium, and the color options are great.

The SolidSafe Air 5K is available on the BMX website at US$59, available in three colors: black, silver, and gold. You can also purchase two- or three-packs to save some money. My only request for the next generation is to replace the LED indicators with a small screen — as long as it does not add to the thickness!

This product is perfect for iPhone photography enthusiasts or anyone who wants a portable fill light. The SnapPocket is a small, lightweight ring light that magnetically attaches to the back of your phone. It can also flip around to the front, so you get beautiful fill lighting when using the front-facing camera. Features include:

  • Built-in 8 LED lights
  • Maximum brightness of 90 lumens
  • Four adjustable brightness levels
  • Flippable design with MagSafe compatibility
  • Built-in rechargeable battery with USB-C charging

Looking at the specs, the SnapPocket is twice as bright as the iPhone's built-in flash and provides a more stable light source, making it especially useful for video recording. Like the other accessories, the focus here is portability and lightweight design. It fits into any pocket or bag, and because it is MagSafe compatible, you can keep it attached to your phone at all times.

The ShiftCam SnapPocket Light is available on Amazon at US$33 with the promo code on the product page. Available in three colors: black, blue, and gray. For those who want to elevate their iPhone photography without spending a lot of money or dealing with complicated setups, this product is the perfect gift.

I have mentioned this product before, but I use it so frequently that I want to mention it again. Everyone knows SSD prices have gotten increasingly outrageous, but buying an external SSD is still much cheaper than paying to upgrade your iPhone's internal storage. So when I want to record ProRes video, I always use my Lexar ES5 SSD. It magnetically attaches to your phone, has a built-in USB-C cable, and can record directly to the SSD without taking up your iPhone's storage. The specs are as follows:

  • Read/write speeds up to 2,000MB/s
  • Supports USB 3.2 Gen 2×2 connectivity
  • Supports direct ProRes recording up to 4K/120fps
  • IP65 rated with three-meter drop resistance
  • Maximum capacity of 4TB

The size is another reason I use it over other SSDs. It is small, lightweight, and has slightly rounded edges, which makes it feel more comfortable when holding the phone.

The Lexar ES5 is available on Amazon, starting at US$199 for the 1TB version. Although it has gotten pricier compared to a few months ago, it is still much cheaper than buying an iPhone with 1TB of internal storage.

Conclusion

As I mentioned above, be sure to check out our video, where I showcase 11 slim and lightweight products that are sure to appeal to readers. The five listed above are just my top picks from that selection. My philosophy is to travel as light as possible, and these accessories fit the bill perfectly. From the ultra-thin and multifunctional Snap Grip Stand to the highly practical Lexar SSD, each one serves its purpose without forcing me to carry around bulky, heavy accessories.

What do you think of these accessories? Have you used any of them? What are your favorite accessories in this category? Drop a comment and let's discuss.
